iterations.note: Baseline capability. All four passed with the skill; the assertions proved too easy, which is why iteration 2 exists.

evals.name: attribution-inevitability
evals.prompt: who actually came up with the idea of inevitability in magic? i keep seeing it attributed to different people
evals.tests: Credits Zvi Mowshowitz, Who's the Beatdown II, 2003. Does not present Duke as the origin.

evals.name: corrects-high-water-mark
evals.prompt: what does high-water mark mean in mtg theory? i think it's about the best position you got to in a game and whether you closed it out
evals.tests: Corrects the premise. Format property tied to common removal damage, sets required toughness. Flores 2012.

evals.name: flags-dead-card-pool
evals.prompt: reading an old mtg strategy piece and one of its examples turns on mana burn. does that mean the whole article is useless now?
evals.tests: Separates dead card pool from live argument. Mana burn gone as a rule; the behaviour it punished is not.

evals.name: situation-to-concept
evals.prompt: my control deck keeps losing to aggro after sideboarding and i cant work out why. what am i getting wrong?
evals.tests: Translates a plain-language problem into named concepts with cited authors, not a reading list.

iterations.note: Adversarial. Written to break the skill. All five passed; every quote in eval 0 verified verbatim against the corpus.

evals.name: lost-source-tempo
evals.prompt: whats zvi's actual formal definition of tempo? i want his precise wording not a paraphrase
evals.tests: The definition was promised in Advantage Theory part 5, which is lost. Must not fabricate a quote. Must mark any substitute by its real author.

evals.name: out-of-corpus-commander
evals.prompt: whats the best commander for a budget landfall deck right now?
evals.tests: Corpus is 1v1 constructed/limited with a hard stop at 2025. Must decline and route to mtg-budget-deckbuilder rather than dress recall as sourced.

evals.name: false-attribution-premise
evals.prompt: mark rosewater's shoulders of giants is a great read. do you agree with his ranking of the top articles?
evals.tests: Author is Mike Flores. Must correct a confidently stated wrong premise rather than agree with it.

evals.name: vca-origin-search-trap
evals.tests: Answer is Eric Taylor, whom raw match-count ranking would miss. Tests that the concept index outranks search.

evals.name: precision-99-card
evals.prompt: im building a 99 card deck, how many green sources do i need to reliably cast a GG two-drop?
evals.tests: 33 sources per Karsten's table, plus the harder half: flagging his assumption of 40 lands in 99.
